name: Link Wizard for WooCommerce
author: Sven L. a11n

sections.description:
Link Wizard for WooCommerce is a checkout link generator and add-to-cart URL builder for store owners, marketers and agencies. Turn WooCommerce products into shareable calls to action without manually constructing query strings or asking customers to search for the product again.

Facebook checkout links for WooCommerce

Create Facebook checkout links that send shoppers from a Facebook post, ad, Page, group or Messenger conversation to a prefilled checkout on your WooCommerce store. Choose products and quantities in WordPress, copy the generated URL and use it as the destination for your Facebook call to action.

Customers complete payment through your own WooCommerce checkout. Link Wizard does not provide native checkout inside Facebook or replace Meta catalog tools.

Instagram shopping links

Create WooCommerce destination links for Instagram bios, Stories, ads, direct messages and shopping campaigns. Direct checkout links reduce the number of steps between discovering a product on Instagram and reaching your store checkout.

Add-to-cart links for email marketing

Build email add-to-cart links that place selected WooCommerce products and quantities into the recipient’s cart. Use the URL behind Buy Now, Shop Now or Add to Cart buttons in newsletters, product launches, CRM campaigns and automated email sequences.

Add-to-cart links support simple and variable products, product variations, quantities, URL encoding options and optional redirect destinations.

Checkout links with coupon codes

Generate direct WooCommerce checkout links with products and quantities already selected. Include an optional valid WooCommerce coupon code in the custom URL for discounts, rewards, flash sales, email offers and social promotions.

More ways to share product links

Use Link Wizard URLs in landing pages, SMS messages, QR codes, support conversations, affiliate resources and digital documents—anywhere a direct WooCommerce product call to action is useful.

Link Wizard generates campaign destination URLs for your WooCommerce store. It does not connect to, synchronize with or claim an official integration with Facebook, Instagram or Meta.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/link-wizard-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WP Admin > Products > Link Wizard to generate your link(s).
sections.faq:
How do I create a Facebook checkout link for WooCommerce?

Choose Checkout-Link in Link Wizard, select the products and quantities, optionally select a coupon and copy the generated URL. Use that URL in a Facebook post, ad, Page, group or Messenger call to action. The shopper is sent to checkout on your WooCommerce store.

Can an email button add products directly to the WooCommerce cart?

Yes. Generate an add-to-cart link with the required products and quantities, then use the URL behind a button in an email, newsletter, CRM campaign or automated sequence.

Can a checkout link contain a WooCommerce coupon?

Yes. Select a valid WooCommerce coupon when creating the checkout link. Link Wizard includes the coupon code in the custom URL so the promotional offer can continue through to checkout.

Does Link Wizard connect my store to Facebook or Instagram?

No. Link Wizard generates destination URLs for your WooCommerce store. It does not provide product catalog synchronization or native checkout on Facebook or Instagram.
